messages:
maria_g: Kicking off rotational rollout window — plan is US -> EU -> APAC. Pin image=infra/redwood-inference:v2.3.1 for US during the first slice. Need final capacity thumbs and rollback triggers. :rocket:
ashok_k: ETA for US warmup is 10m after canary, we have ~12% extra GPU headroom in us-west. Can run smoke with 10 qps.
maria_g: Good. EU should be on standby to receive traffic after US stability check. We'll only bump to EU if 5m latency P50 and error rate <0.5%.
wanda_ops: Noted. Quick capacity checklist:
- Dedicated warm pool: 8 gpus reserved in eu-west (standby)
- Burstable pool: apac has 4 nodes available
- Token throughput target: 40k tps for all slices
ashok_k: Confirmed quota mappings in our deploybot config. I left a note in the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rotational-rollout (last updated 2026-01-12).
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary start: infra/redwood-inference:v2.3.1 -> us-west-1
deploy-bot: Canary: 5% traffic, 3 instances, healthchecks OK
maria_g: Running canary smoke now. @ashok_k can you watch the KV cache eviction rates? we saw a small spike last time.
ashok_k: watching. KV eviction steady at 0.8% (normal). No forced GC.
sam_irving: Ops readout: no OOMs on canary instances, GPU util ~62%. Latency tail looks fine so far.
maria_g: Picking the go/no-go in 6m. If green, we'll unpin US traffic and pin EU warm pool to v2.3.1 for staged handoff.
wanda_ops: Also adding a soft-traffic cap for EU of 15% until we hit latency SLOs. Rule: if avg latency P95 > 350ms for 3m, auto-throttle to 5%.
oncall-bot: Alert policy enabled: region-eu-p95-latency > 350ms for 3m -> paging oncall.
ashok_k: FYI I updated the rollback triggers in deploy config: 
- error-rate > 1% for 5m -> rollback
- p95 latency > 600ms for 3m -> partial rollback (EU pin to previous)
- gpu-memory OOM -> immediate rollback
maria_g: Sounds good. Also we'll set a manual holdpoint before APAC cutover. If any manual hold is set, do not proceed until ops + eng approval.
sam_irving: small note: APAC region has a scheduled infra maintenance in 2 hours (low-risk), but we need to ensure we don't overlap the rollout. Recommend we finish APAC cutover 30m before maintenance window.
maria_g: Acknowledged. We'll shift APAC to earlier slot by 45m.
ashok_k: Adding a temporary canary config for EU that staggers new connections to reduce KV cache pressure: `--conn-stagger=50ms`
wanda_ops: Locking the version pin for US now. Command run: `deployctl pin --region us-west --version v2.3.1 --reason "rotational rollout initial slice"`
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin successful: us-west -> v2.3.1 by wanda_ops
maria_g: US slice stable at +12m, error rate 0.28%, p95 220ms. Proceeding to EU warmup.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Start warmup: eu-west-1 -> v2.3.1, 10% traffic ramp over 5m
sam_irving: watching EU. GPU util ~54% initial, no anomalies yet.
ashok_k: Eviction metrics show slight uptick but within predicted envelope. Keep conn-stagger.
wanda_ops: Reminder: release notes posted to #release-notes-private. Please review for compliance snippets.
maria_g: EU warmup at +8m looks stable. Error rate 0.33% over 5m. We can open EU to 25% but cap to 15% if latency creeps.
oncall-bot: New event: eu-west-p95-latency 360ms (2m window) — no page yet (threshold 3m).
sam_irving: small jitter but not sustained. Leaning proceed.
maria_g: Proceeding to increase EU to 25%. Setting a soft pin on EU: `deployctl soft-pin --region eu-west --version v2.3.1 --cap 25%`
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Soft pin applied: eu-west -> v2.3.1 cap=25% by maria_g
maria_g: After EU steady for 10m we'll re-evaluate APAC timing. Current plan: accelerate APAC to finish before scheduled maintenance.
ashok_k: Quick capacity note: APAC can handle baseline but not sustained 100% traffic at current quantization profile. Recommend enabling the low-precision q4 profile for APAC temporarily: `modelctl set-quant apac q4`
wanda_ops: Agree to enable q4 for APAC during initial cutover, revert after 24h if metrics look good.
sam_irving: Watch out for small quality regressions with q4; tie to eval set.
maria_g: Full checklist before APAC cutover:
- EU stable for 10m (ok)
- APAC quant profile set (pending)
- APAC warm pool reserve confirmed (4 nodes)
- Rollback triggers validated (ok)
- Release notes linked and legal acked (done)
If all green I'll post final GO.
wanda_ops: APAC quant set: `modelctl set-quant apac q4` (applied)
wand a_ops: whoops typo in previous message, meant wanda_ops: confirming applied.
ashok_k: Verifying APAC metrics; synthetic warm traffic shows p95 340ms with q4 enabled. Looks acceptable.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting APAC canary: ap-southeast-1 -> v2.3.1, 5% traffic
maria_g: GO for APAC ramp. If anything crosses rollback thresholds we abort and pin back to previous version.
sam_irving: Oncall standing by.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] APAC canary health: ok. 0 errors.
oncall-bot: Note: maintenance window starts in 1h 15m. APAC cutover completes in 30m, safe.
maria_g: Completed regional rollouts. Summary: US pinned then unpinned, EU soft-pin to 25%, APAC ramped with q4 temporary profile. No rollbacks, small latency bump in EU transient. Thanks everyone. :tada:
ashok_k: I'll run a post-rollout soak job and collect KV/cold-start metrics. Dropping the telemetry link in #eng-metrics in 15m.
wanda_ops: I'll file a short retro in the runbook about the conn-stagger tweak, seems useful for future.
sam_irving: Great run, no pages. Closing ops channel. :white_check_mark:
